fields.name: job_title
fields.description: The advertised title of the open role, as shown on the careers page.

fields.name: location
fields.description: The role's location string exactly as posted (may be 'Remote', a city, or 'Remote - City').

fields.name: application_url
fields.description: Direct URL to the individual job posting's application form.

fields.name: location_type
fields.description: Bonus field emitted by the scraper - Ashby's categorization (e.g. 'On-site', 'Remote', 'Applied AI').

fields.name: product_page_url
fields.description: Bonus field emitted by the scraper - canonical page URL for the role on Ashby.

planned_v2_fields.name: department
planned_v2_fields.description: Internal department/team the role belongs to (e.g. Engineering, Sales). Reserved for a later self-heal demo - not extracted in v1.

planned_v2_fields.name: employment_type
planned_v2_fields.description: Full-time / Part-time / Contract / Intern. Reserved for a later self-heal demo - not extracted in v1.

planned_v2_fields.name: date_posted
planned_v2_fields.description: Date the role was posted, as a string in the source's own format. Reserved for a later self-heal demo - not extracted in v1.
